symptoms_en: Scattered yellow spots on young leaves, then irregular yellow and green patches; some leaves turn fully yellow; plants are stunted, mature late and set very few flowers and pods. More common on urad (black gram) than moong. Spread by whitefly.
symptoms_hi: नई पत्तियों पर बिखरे पीले धब्बे, फिर पीले-हरे अनियमित चकत्ते; कुछ पत्तियाँ पूरी पीली हो जाती हैं; पौधे बौने रहते हैं, देर से पकते हैं और बहुत कम फूल-फलियाँ देते हैं। उड़द में मूंग से ज़्यादा होता है। यह सफ़ेद मक्खी से फैलता है।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of greengram
symptoms_en.quote: Initially mild scattered yellow spots appear on young leaves. The next trifoliate leaves emerging from the growing apex show irregular yellow and green patches alternating with each other.

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of greengram
symptoms_en.quote: Diseased plants are stunted, mature late and produce very few flowers and pods.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of black and green gram
management_en.quote: Install yellow sticky traps @ 5/ac to attract the whiteflies

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For sucking pests (like thrips and whitefly) in the early stage: Spray Neemastra @ 200 litres per acre
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Fungus/Virus control: Spray 3–4 days old buttermilk mixed with 100 litres of water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Install yellow sticky traps (5 per acre) to attract whiteflies.
management_hi: सफ़ेद मक्खी को आकर्षित करने के लिए पीले चिपचिपे ट्रैप (5 प्रति एकड़) लगाएँ।
